title: The Oslo Rice Pile Relaxes Exactly in L(L+1) Steps
description: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper proving that the evolution operator of the Oslo rice pile on L sites satisfies W^(n+1) = W^n first at n = L(L+1), not at n = L(L+1)/2 as stated by Dhar: a configuration with g grains reaches the steady state after exactly L(L+1) - g + [last slope = 2] added grains, and the decorrelation time L(L+1)/2 holds exactly on recurrent configurations.
